description: Source code for glyph loading routines in the FreeType font rendering library, specifically for auto-hinting and outline transformations.

methods.name: af_loader_init
methods.description: Initializes the glyph loader with hints.

methods.name: af_loader_reset
methods.description: Resets the glyph loader and initializes face globals if needed.

methods.name: af_loader_done
methods.description: Finalizes the glyph loader, clearing references.

methods.name: af_loader_load_glyph
methods.description: Loads a glyph, applies hinting, and computes metrics and outline transformations.
